title: Device counts
description: A small outlined box with an icon and a count for each device type (Tablets, Smart Boots, Pull Boxes, DomeBLE). Inside a Facility row it shrinks in steps as the row gets narrower: all four, then two with a "+2" button, then a single "N devices" button; both buttons open a list of every count. On its own it shows all four.

props.x: One entry per device type. icon is an image URL. The first two are kept when the box narrows.
Number shown on the single button when the box is at its narrowest.
